pretreatments.description: Peracetic acid, a potent oxidizing agent that breaks down extracellular polymeric substances and intracellular organic matter, enhancing microbial activity and reducing pretreatment costs.
Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) and calcium peroxide (CaO₂) as oxidants that degrade sludge components, improving substrate solubility and microbial efficiency.
Potassium permanganate (KMnO₄) facilitates oxidation of organic matter, enhancing hydrolysis and reducing inhibition of microbial processes.
Chemical pretreatment with acetic acid (implied via PAA's role) and other catalysts to accelerate sludge breakdown and nutrient availability.
